install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-eea44d04dc4a1fd91f52，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dshp 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序、插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eea44d04dc4a1fd91f52.html
posts.en:
dshp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eea44d04dc4a1fd91f52.html
